title: Burst window
what: Sums the new and cached tokens of the recent requests by project, largest first, for a burst siren (src/burst.rs).

title: Request classification
what: Decides what kind a model request is and names the likely cause of a re-prefill, from the session's flags and the gap since its previous request (src/attribution.rs).

title: Request levels and labels
what: The alert level a Usage carries, and the short text a request label, a note or a count is written with (src/event.rs).

title: Model rates and names
what: The estimated rates and the billing backend of a model identifier, and the readable name the screens show (src/models.rs).
